author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam checks out the original Frank the Bunny mask and costume from the cult classic 2001 film Donnie Darko! The design of Frank has etched itself into the minds of film fans for a generation, and still stands as one of the great surreal horror designs. Plus, how the prop department of Donnie Darko created its mysterious book, "The Philosophy of Time Travel". 

Learn more about this costume and the upcoming Propstore EMLA auction: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/525
See all the props and costumes in this auction in the catalog: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/525

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
